notes:
Steam 慢启动不再在约 90 秒就弹出失败，会继续等待；只有仍没有进程才提示失败。游戏没在跑时，应用不再误报 Loader 未注入。诊断包在游戏占用 Latest.log 时也能读入。
A slow Steam start is no longer a failure at about 90 seconds; the manager keeps waiting and only reports failure if the process never appears. Applying no longer reports Loader not injected while the game is not running. Diagnostic packs can still read Latest.log while the game has it open.
